content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desired experience, as printed: The candidate should be excellent in Programming and Data Structures, Probability and Statistics, Discrete Maths. The work will involve advanced Generative AI modals, and publications in top-tier Journals and Conferences.

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent, and 4 years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to 56000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The tenure is 24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice calls it a temporary assignment.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Scientist - I - Research posts are there at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts of Project Scientist - I - Research in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Scientist - I - Research?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent, and 4 years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Scientist - I - Research?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 56000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is printed as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the tenure?
faq.answer: The tenure is 24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the recruitment for, and who funds it?
faq.answer: The posts are for IndiaCAN-Twin: Towards AI-Powered Digital Twin Platform for Early Detection and Personalized Care in Indian Oral Cancer (Project Code – R/IND), sponsored by DBT, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Does meeting the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
